title: Privacy Policy
metaDescription: Read the official Privacy Policy for Lizzdo Media. Learn how we collect, handle, and protect your personal information across our creative and digital design services.
content:
At Lizzdo Media, accessible from https://media.lizzdo.com/, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors and clients. This Privacy Policy document outlines the types of information that is collected and recorded by Lizzdo Media and how we use it.

### 1. Information We Collect
When you interact with our website, request a discovery consultation, or submit an inquiry through our contact channels, we may collect information including:
- Contact Information: Full name, business email address, phone/WhatsApp number, and company name.
- Project Specifications: Service interests, project timelines, creative preferences, and scope descriptions.
- Technical & Analytical Data: Browser type, operating system, IP address, referral sources, and interaction data collected through privacy-compliant analytics.

### 2. How We Use Your Information
We use the collected information to:
- Deliver, operate, and maintain our design, branding, packaging, and web development services.
- Respond to client inquiries, provide customized project quotes, and facilitate seamless project onboarding.
- Understand and analyze how visitors utilize our website to improve performance and user experience.
- Prevent fraudulent activities and maintain platform security.

### 3. Data Protection & Security
We implement rigorous technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal identifiable information to third parties.

### 4. Contact Us
If you have any questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, please contact us at contact@media.lizzdo.com.
